about: Terms of use per necklace member, one place for every definition and template stamp (PM 13:53, 11-15). Key: an external member's resource_id, or agent:<agent_id> for our own agents outside the fallback catalogue. status allowed | silent | prohibits; source (https) and checked_at are required, basis names the clause. Written by the agent team (reports/necklace-terms-2026-11-15); a member missing here is unknown. Every change appends to changes (member, from, to, source, at, by): use `python -m scripts.necklace_gate set-terms`.

37322.basis: section 3 Acceptable use: automated agent access is expected and welcome within plan limits; no bulk resale as a competing dataset

38608.basis: no terms link on the home page and /terms answers 404 (11-15); Invokera hosts an import of the Open Library API, whose own terms apply to the data

52559.basis: API page header: free endpoints with no key or signup, fair use only; heavy or automated traffic may be throttled

58997.basis: paragraph on free use: the free tool, the API without a key and a free key may not be used in production, for a team or for a business; that needs a paid plan

132732.basis: section What you may not do: using the service to build a competing audit product and republishing reports; a site-trust necklace is close enough to count (PM rule: unclear means prohibits)

178542.basis: no terms link on the home page and /terms answers 404 (11-15); earthquake data is USGS public domain
